description: Add a consolidated GET /api/health-twin/ backend endpoint that returns the authenticated patient's profile, predictions, pathology reports, and prescriptions in a single call. This eliminates 4 parallel requests from the DigitalTwin page and ensures data is scoped to the authenticated user. This feature is independent of FEAT-003 (either order is valid) but is placed last since FEAT-003 calls it.
steps:
STEP 1 — Add health_twin_view to backend/medical/views.py: At the end of the file, add a new function decorated with @api_view(['GET']) and @permission_classes([IsAuthenticated]). The function:
  - Gets request.user.
  - Retrieves the Patient object via Patient.objects.get(user=user); returns 404 if not found.
  - Builds profile_data dict: { id, name, first_name, last_name, blood_group, allergies (parsed JSON list), dob (isoformat or ''), gender, weight (weight_kg), height (height_cm), emergency_contact }.
  - Fetches predictions = [p.to_dict() for p in patient.predictions.order_by('-created_at')[:20]].
  - Fetches pathology = [r.to_dict() for r in patient.pathology_reports.order_by('-created_at')[:20]].
  - Fetches prescriptions = [p.to_dict() for p in patient.prescriptions.order_by('-created_at')[:10]].
  - Returns JsonResponse({ 'profile': profile_data, 'predictions': predictions, 'pathology_reports': pathology, 'prescriptions': prescriptions }, status=200).
  - Uses existing json import (already imported at top of views.py). Uses existing Patient import (already imported). Uses existing to_dict() methods on models.

STEP 2 — Register endpoint in backend/medical/urls.py: Add re_path(r'^health-twin/?$', views.health_twin_view, name='health_twin') to the urlpatterns list, alongside the other telemetry routes. The 'views' module is already imported at the top of urls.py.
acceptance_criteria: python manage.py check in backend/ exits 0.
GET /api/health-twin/ with a valid JWT returns HTTP 200 with keys: profile, predictions, pathology_reports, prescriptions.
Data is scoped to the authenticated patient (a patient cannot see another patient's data).
The profile.allergies field is a JSON array (not a raw string).
The endpoint does not expose any data for Doctor role users (returns 404 since they have no Patient record).
findings: health_twin_view added at end of backend/medical/views.py under FEAT-004 section comment. re_path registered in backend/medical/urls.py. python manage.py check reports 0 issues. No models touched, no migrations run. Existing json and Patient imports reused.
